title: FIABC S35 HQ fan-in
claim: GSS1973 is an L2 documentary debt; generic portability may not invent source-specific form/routing/weight semantics.
caveat: Repository law; not source-semantic evidence by itself.

title: Authority71 R05 GSS return
claim: Canonical GSS1973 SHA; 1504 rows; 339 vars; split-form X/Y; income rename/equivalence and weight/routing gaps preserved.

title: 1973 GSS Questionnaire
claim: Q56 chooses X/Y by questionnaire-cover letter; X has four class names and Y five. Q101 asks 1972 family income before taxes. Q105 is a separate Card X/Y experiment with its own route.
caveat: Q105 machine text has an internally inconsistent digit list; do not operationalize that list without visual verification.

title: Appendix P — Experimental Forms
claim: 1973 used split sample; FORM=1 standard; FORM=2 y variant; Table P.1 is the exhaustive register of form-different/order/form-only questions.
caveat: Use the 1973 column; never infer form membership from variable suffix alone.

title: 1972-2018 Cumulative Codebook — FORM
claim: Split ballot used in 1973; Form 2 carries Y wording; Form 1 carries standard wording.
caveat: Cumulative frequency bins are not exact 1973 form counts.

title: 1972-2018 Cumulative Codebook — CLASSY
claim: CLASSY appeared on Form 2 in 1973 and is a variant of CLASS.
caveat: Variant relationship does not authorize value-space collapse.

title: GSS Methodological Report 36 — Problems in Form Randomization
locator: Form Randomization Procedures; Block Quota Surveys 1973/1974/1976
claim: For 1973, X/Y form assignment was randomized within quota types via quota assignment sheet; after respondent selection form was not interviewer-discretionary. The later flaw concerns 1978-1985.
caveat: Do not back-project the later FORMWT repair to 1973.

title: Appendix A — Sampling Design and Weighting
claim: 1973 is multi-stage area probability through block/segment, then quota selection using sex, age and employment-status quotas.
caveat: Quota design is not the later full-probability design.

title: GSS Methodological Report 137 — Post-stratification Weights for GSS 1972-2022
locator: methods and footnote on design estimation
claim: WTSSPS post-stratification is explicitly extended to historical GSS years; strata/clustering are not used for survey estimation in 1972-1974 because quota sampling was used.
caveat: Modern producer-authorized historical weight; does not alter original 1973 questionnaire routing.

title: GSS FAQ — weights
locator: Do I need to use weights?
claim: NORC recommends WTSSPS for most analyses; it spans 1972-2024. WTSSNRPS is only 2004-2024.
caveat: Current recommendation; use only if exact source realization exposes the authorized weight field.

title: Release Notes GSS 1972-2022 Release 2
claim: Post-stratification weights were added to 1972-1987 to support analysis of the historical series with a single weight.
caveat: Release history supports explicit backward applicability.

title: Repeated Items in the General Social Survey
claim: Income variable chronology: INCOME72 in 1972; INCOME since 1973; later vintage variables reflect expansion of income ranges over time.

title: Appendix N — Changes in Question Wording Response Categories and Format
claim: Income response categories were revised between 1972 and 1973; revised groupings are treated as separate questions and variables.
caveat: Directly defeats INCOME72=INCOME equivalence by name/label similarity.

title: GSS SPSS download/documentation page
locator: current cumulative and single-year release notice
claim: Modern SPSS releases standardize negative missing-value encodings and publish individual-year 1973 data.
caveat: Encoding standardization is physical representation; it does not by itself classify form-not-administered versus routed skip.
